_status: Younes's interim values, used only until Youcef pushes params/battery.json. Top-level values: typical 51.2 V 100 Ah LFP home battery (TO CONFIRM with a datasheet). 'aging' block: Naumann et al. 2018 (calendar) and 2020 (cycle), checked against the authors' SimSES code.
sources: Ageing coefficients: Naumann M., Schimpe M., Keil P., Hesse H.C., Jossen A., 'Analysis and modeling of calendar aging of a commercial LiFePO4/graphite cell', J. Energy Storage 17 (2018) 153-169, doi:10.1016/j.est.2018.01.019; Naumann M., Spingler F.B., Jossen A., 'Analysis and modeling of cycle aging of a commercial LiFePO4/graphite cell', J. Power Sources 451 (2020) 227666. Values checked identical to the authors' open-source implementation SimSES (TU Munich, PyPI simses 2.1.1, sony_lfp_calendar.py / sony_lfp_cyclic.py). Efficiencies, C-rate and capacity: typical 51.2 V 100 Ah LFP home battery datasheets (TO CONFIRM, Youcef).
